newsitem.title: ITALY: Fifty people said hurt in Italian motorway pile-up.
newsitem.headline: Fifty people said hurt in Italian motorway pile-up.

text.p: About 50 people were injured on Monday in a 200-car pile-up in heavy fog on a motorway near Venice in northeastern Italy.
Traffic in both directions on the A-13 motorway between Venice and the city of Padua was rerouted so rescue and clean-up efforts could proceed.
One person was seriously injured, authorities said.
